changes.now: Gorr, a man who lost his daughter and his faith, starts killing gods, and Jane returns as the Mighty Thor, wielding a reforged Mjolnir that is also hastening her death from cancer. They chase Gorr to Eternity, and Jane dies saving the universe. Gorr uses his wish to bring back his daughter and asks Thor to raise her. Thor becomes a father to a girl named Love.
changes.proposed: Gorr, a man who lost his daughter and his faith, starts killing gods, and Jane returns as the Mighty Thor, wielding a reforged Mjolnir that is also hastening her death from cancer. They chase Gorr to Eternity, and Jane dies after joining the fight to save Thor. Gorr uses his wish to bring back his daughter and asks Thor to raise her. Thor becomes a father to a girl named Love.
changes.evidence: Gorr's wish at Eternity was to destroy the gods, not the universe. Jane joins the battle with Mjolnir to save Thor when Gorr is about to kill him; they destroy the Necrosword, and she then succumbs to her illness and dies in Thor's arms. Thor, not Jane, talks Gorr into wishing for his daughter instead.
